items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: And I knew Johnny. He was a band harmonica player, if I'm not mistaken, also.

ctx.x: I think almost all those Crescent City Jazzers ago. Jeff Riddick's brother, Johnny, played with him at one time.
That's right. And I knew Johnny. He was a band harmonica player, if I'm not mistaken, also. Really?
